## Checklist

- [ ] The Pull Request addresses one task / user story.
- [ ] No secrets or real credentials are committed.
- [ ] Database changes remain inside the `-db` repository.
- [ ] MongoDB changesets are idempotent and reversible.
- [ ] CI is green.
- [ ] The Pull Request stays within the 400-line limit, excluding tests and generated files.
